name: All Star Bulk Order Block
description: All Star Embroidery bulk ordering, artwork review, and WooCommerce My Account experience.
changelog:
1.2.1

  • Fixes Approve Artwork and Request Changes by replacing invalid nested WooCommerce admin forms with authenticated AJAX review actions.
  • Fixes the My Account Artwork tab 404 with refreshed rewrite rules and a reliable fallback route.
  • Corrects Billing and Shipping address alignment into a true two-column desktop/tablet layout.
  • Restyles My Account and customer artwork with a lighter HeroUI-inspired surface system: fewer cards, minimal shadows, natural lists, soft fields, subtle separators and restrained All Star navy/gold accents.
  • No Supplier Sync pricing, cart, shipping, checkout, artwork storage or order-security behavior changed.
